title: Lightning Turns Sand Into Glass Tubes at 50,000 Degrees

scenes.text: When lightning hits sand, it makes glass.
A bolt can reach about 50,000 degrees Fahrenheit, hotter than the Sun's surface.
It vaporizes the sand in its path and melts the sand around it.
In an instant, the sand fuses into a hollow glass tube.
It's called a fulgurite, from the Latin word for thunderbolt.
Lightning, sand, and a tube of glass.

description:
